preconditions.description: Both fullText and searchText must be strings.

postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer.
The return value must be non-negative.
If searchText is an empty string, the return value must be 0.

postconditions.expression: all(searchText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1)) if allowOverlap else all(searchText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if i == 0 or i > 0 and fullText[i-1] != searchText[0])
postconditions.description: The return value counts the number of non-overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText.
